function.arguments: {"observation": "`assay_batch` has two values: 'A' (587 rows) and 'B' (261 rows). Since 1 µg/L = 10 ng/mL, batch-B values must be divided by 10 to convert to ng/mL.", "implication": "If we do not convert batch-B `biomarker_final` values to ng/mL, the mean will be inflated by a factor of 10, leading to a completely incorrect result. We must divide all `biomarker_final` values where `assay_batch == 'B'` by 10 before computing the mean."}
function.name: note_finding
